title: Jadakiss Responds to 38 Spesh on Track With Fat Joe & Stove God Cooks: ‘Is This About a Verse or Is This About a Career?’
summary: Fat Joe premiered a new track entitled "Aroma" on his Joe and Jada podcast with the help of DJ Khaled.
contentText:
Jadakiss did what he said he was gonna do.

Last month , a clip surfaced on social media of ‘Kiss telling a group of people that he was on his way to the studio “to do some samurai swording,” seemingly in response to rapper 38 Spesh alleging on the BagFuel podcast that the Yonkers rapper has been ducking him since their “Sunday School” collaboration. “I did a record with Benny and ‘Kiss, and I happened to have the best verse on the record,” he said. “I smoked the record, and ‘Kiss never did a song with me again. And I don’t think he’ll ever do a song with me again.”

Related

Jadakiss Heading to the Studio After Being Called Out by 38 Spesh: ‘I’m ‘Bout to Do Some Samurai Swording’

50 Cent to Produce Podcast Hosted by Jadakiss Exploring DMX’s Life Story

Jadakiss Reacts to Drake’s ‘What Did I Miss?’: ‘They Flip on You … That’s the Game We In’

Now it looks like the rap legend has made good on his promise.

On Thursday (July 9), with the help of DJ Khaled as their hype man, Fat Joe and ‘Kiss debuted a new song featuring Stove God Cooks from Crack’s upcoming album Organized Crhyme on their Joe and Jada podcast, and Manteca Jada sent a couple jabs Spesh’s way with bars like, “A OG, I’m more like Juan, than Anunoby/ B.I.G., Frank Matthews, a splash of Kobe/ Bruce Lee, Muhammad Ali, half Shinobi / I been obliterating n—as for years/ Is this about a verse or is this about a career?/ Ask around, they tell you I’m the career repo/ New York love me like when Mitch hit a pair of free throws,” where he references his earlier “samurai swording” comment by referencing the classic Sega video game Shinobi while asking if all this is really over him not giving 38 a verse.

We now wait for the Rochester MC to respond.
